entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: The Java War, also known in Indonesia as the Diponegoro War, was an armed conflict in central and eastern Java from 1825 to 1830, between native Javanese rebels headed by Prince Diponegoro and the Dutch East Indies supported by Javanese princely states. It is considered a watershed in Javanese history, culture, and society.
